limits.breaker: Loop breaker, always on: a chain deeper than {relayMax} hops wakes nobody; {botMessages} bot messages since the last human message, or {repeats} identical messages from one bot, pause the chat until a person writes.
limits.intro: Counters that bound a conversation and a run. A blank field uses the default. A change applies to the next bot message and to runs that start afterwards; running and parked runs keep the limits they started with.
limits.invalid: {name}: enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
limits.key.continuationLimit: Continuations after running out of turns
limits.key.continuationWindowHours: Hours to answer a continuation request
limits.key.relayCountMax: Relay cap (hops in one message chain)
limits.key.turnBudget: Turn budget (bot messages per chat since the last human message)
limits.offNeedsBudget: Off is available once this workspace has a weekly or cumulative budget (Costs page).
limits.title: Execution limits
